\noindent\footnotesize Each cell compares generated-library \AC\ leading-colour production against \PAC\ staged-DAG JIT O1 at the same final-state multiplicity \(n\).  Generation builds exact LC replay partitions covering all colour orderings; the \PAC\ selected-flow slot times the matched LC sector with the usual helicity sum, while the all-flow slot times the replay-partition aggregate for one deterministic fixed source helicity.  The \AC\ slot shows selected-flow/all-flow values separated by \texttt{/}; the all-flow \AC\ timing uses the same fixed-helicity colour probe.  \PAC\ runtime multipliers use wall time relative to the corresponding selected-flow or all-flow \AC\ number.  Generation entries are in seconds; \AC\ runtime entries and absolute \PAC\ runtimes are in microseconds per point. If no direct \AC\ reference exists, completed \PAC\ slots show absolute timings. Ratio colours are green below one, orange below two, and red otherwise.  The summary rows give \texttt{min|max|avg|med}; multiplier summaries add \texttt{sum}, the ratio of paired summed \PAC\ and \AC\ times.  For LC, the two runtime summary rows match the one-flow helicity-summed and all-flow fixed-helicity runtime slots.  Missing and structural N/A cells are ignored.  Validated rows use the same phase-space point and a \(10^{-8}\) relative tolerance.
\par\smallskip
\noindent\footnotesize A red \textbf{VALIDATION FAILED} marker is shown next to any validated entry whose relative difference exceeds \(10^{-8}\).
\par\smallskip

\paragraph{Matrix run settings.}
\noindent\footnotesize Generated by \path{docs/result_matrix.py} with \texttt{--color-accuracy lc}, from \path{result_matrix_data.json} into \path{result_matrix_table.tex}. \AC\ uses generated-library creation, direct timing of the first group/integral, and a fixed-helicity colour probe for all-flow timing. \PAC\ JIT writes a pruned \texttt{selected\_flow} artifact for the matched helicity-summed LC sector and an \texttt{all\_flows} \texttt{--lc-topology-replay} artifact for the exact all-ordering fixed-helicity sum.  The all-flow generation time reported in each cell is the generation time of that replay-partition artifact. \PAC\ uses Rusticol double precision, batch size 64, output chunk size 128, stage-local evaluator inputs, ten Horner iterations, Symbolica's default CPE iteration choice, and enlarged Horner/common-pair limits.  JIT rows use SymJIT \(\mathrm{O}1\); timing runs use \texttt{--target-runtime 10}.  The LC matrix displays the selected-flow and all-flow JIT workloads side by side.
